title: StewardMD Standard Protocol
description: Platform-owned, hospital-AGNOSTIC, evidence-informed oncology treatment protocol - StewardMD's own structured clinical object. NOT an NCCN/DeVita/Harrison/ASCO/ESMO protocol and never claims endorsement. Hospital-specific configuration lives in a SEPARATE hospital-implementation overlay (see hospital-implementation.schema.json), keyed by hospitalId; no hospital is hard-coded here. A patient-specific instance is a Treatment Plan (separate object). Required fields the source does not support MUST be the literal string "VERIFY" (never invented/inferred); any unresolved VERIFY blocks status ACTIVE.

verifiable.description: A value that is either concretely sourced, or the literal VERIFY when a source does not establish it (never invented). anyOf (not oneOf): the string "VERIFY" legitimately matches both the generic-string branch and the const branch, which would make oneOf fail.

provenance.description: Machine-readable provenance for a clinical rule. layer: which evidence layer this came from.

source.description: e.g. 'DeVita 12th ed', 'Harrison 22nd ed', 'NCCN <panel>', 'ASCO', 'ESMO', or a hospital implementation label. NEVER an endorsement claim.

locator.description: Exact internal source location (page/section/line). No verbatim reproduction of copyrighted text.

name.description: Apply ISMP tall-man where applicable (DOXOrubicin, vinCRIStine, CARBOplatin, CISplatin).

dosePerUnit.description: Exact sourced dose (number), or the target AUC when basis=auc, or VERIFY / null when the source omits it.

name.description: StewardMD Standard Protocol display name, e.g. 'FOLFOX-6'.

diseaseId.description: Maps to a kb/reference/<id>.json disease id, or null.

treatmentSetting.description: neoadjuvant | adjuvant | metastatic | maintenance | ... or VERIFY.

eligibilityCriteria.description: Structured, machine-matchable criteria for the recommendation engine.

exclusionCriteria.description: Only where source-supported; omit rather than invent.

supportiveCare.description: Antiemetic tier (emetogenicity) + G-CSF (FN risk); sourced, else VERIFY.

evidence.description: Three layers, never flattened. Core = long-lived textbook framework; guideline = currentness overlay (NCCN/ASCO/ESMO/peer-reviewed where legitimately available); institutional = per-hospital-tenant overlays. divergence surfaces conflicts, never auto-reconciled.

institutional.description: Per-tenant, keyed by hospitalId; never a hard-coded hospital. Actual overlay lives in hospital-implementation.schema.json.

protocolVersion.description: semver of the GLOBAL StewardMD core protocol, e.g. '1.0'. Hospital implementations version as '<protocolVersion>-<HOSPITAL>' in the overlay, not here.

clinicalApprovalStatus.description: StewardMD platform-level clinical (R1) governance state of THIS global version. Distinct from any hospital approval, which lives on the hospital-implementation overlay.

verifyFields.description: Dotted paths of every field currently set to VERIFY. Must be empty before status can become ACTIVE.

audit.description: Immutable event log: create/review/approve/supersede/retire, with user + timestamp.

provenanceNote.description: Human note. No endorsement claims ('NCCN-approved' etc.) permitted.
